6213112d.text:
My dearest Tabitha,

How strange it is to foretell my own death. I've written this note as I do not know the hour when fate will claim me and although I know that this is a poor apology for a proper speech, my quill fails in its attempt to convey my pain for departing from you.

Every day I wake to the sorrow I failed to protect you from. I am sorry I could not protect our dear boy and I am sorry that my grieving has fallen into a trap from which it cannot escape.

You are my love, and my confidante and my life counted for more than it could alone. Every week when I venture into the ruins of our once proud home, I fear it would be my last, and every time I am thankful I have you to return to.

I pray we are reunited, if even for a moment.
6213112d.title: Blood-Stained Letter

Well, if it isn't a young, bristling $c, no doubt drawn here by talk of my exploits in fields of battle!

No time for stories now, for there are great, important deeds that need doing!  So if you're looking for glory, then luck shines on you today...

1347|0624ab70.name: Alexandra Bolero
1347|0624ab70.text: Since the fall of Dalaran and the destruction of Quel'Thalas, wares of this sort have been hard to come by. But Lucan Cordell and some of our other Tradesman have been doing a fine job of filling our orders with quality merchandise.

1351|a96dc031.text: May the light guide your path and aid you in your journies. If you need any assistance browsing, I will be right over here.

14450|d3e1a5a0.name: Orphan Matron Nightingale
14450|d3e1a5a0.text:
There are costs with war, $c... ones often overlooked.  Those costs are the orphans - children who have lost their parents to the far-too-numerous conflicts that rage across Azeroth.  Those children who have no one else to turn to often come here to live until they are old enough to fend for themselves.

One week out of the year during the Spring, the Alliance takes time to give something back to these innocents.  This time is called Children's Week.

14982|755d8f77.text: $C, we need your assistance at Warsong Gulch.  Will you aid us in our fight against the Warsong Outriders?

15351|f54c92d6.name: Alliance Brigadier General
15351|f54c92d6.text: The war against the Horde has reached full tilt, $N.  This is a time of great need for the Alliance and it's quite necessary that all of us do our part to help.

1571|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

1703|d69277e0.name: Uthrar Threx

234|eba492ed.text: A foul corruption has crept into Westfall.  While I was upholding my duty on the battlefields of Lordaeron these honest farms were overrun and made into hide-outs for thugs and murderers. The People's Militia needs your help.

Well take a number and get comfortable.  I'm working on a couple engines right now and won't have time for another job for at least a few days.

Or, were you here for something else...?

Something exciting, I hope.  I haven't been in a good fight in days, and this barrel of ale is almost dry...

95250-accept.name: Unknown
95250-accept.text:
What do you want, $r? Can't you see there is a war to be won?

My master has already charged into the fray and has ordered me to maintain my post. It has been quite some time, however.

I doubt you'll survive ten minutes in combat, but if it keeps your simple mind busy, why don't you seek out the Grand Marshal. He is the tallest, most statuesque hero you've ever laid eyes on. You'll know him when you see him.
95250-accept.title: Abominable Creatures

95250-complete.name: Unknown
95250-complete.text:
<Truman looks at the head of his former lord in horror and disgust.>

Is this... some kind of joke? Why would you bring me this monstrosity's head?

Get out of my sight! I should have known better than to trust a filthy lesser breed like you. The true sons of Lordaeron will reclaim our home. And when we do we'll finally be free to purge it of beasts like you!
95250-complete.title: Abominable Creatures

95250-progress.name: Unknown
95250-progress.text: You're still alive? Hmmph. Well, what is it? Have you found my lord yet?
95250-progress.title: Abominable Creatures

96395-accept.name: Unknown
96395-accept.text:
The... Thane... my mighty... Thane... he... needs to... rest.

Please... help him... help him... rest...

Consumed... by... ancient... grudge... No... rest...
96395-accept.title: An Ancient Grudge

96395-complete.name: Unknown

My... Thane... he... rests... yes... rest.

Thank... you...

I... rest...
